title: Research runtime, evidence, report, and conclusion
summary: A scientific run binds exact prerequisites, validates typed results, promotes reviewed evidence, and emits deterministic reports and conclusions.

assertions.description: Runtime preflight binds every inherited prerequisite to a concrete asset, exact argv path, and provenance-current typed result.
Workers create evidence candidates; only a provenance-bound passing review promotes evidence.
Identical normalized inputs produce byte-stable JSON and Markdown evidence ledgers.
Conclusions cite current promoted evidence, preserve limitations, and cannot overstate failed or inconclusive gates.
